findings.message: Deterministic heuristic occurrence re-evaluated as false positive on this candidate.

Its only dynamic input is a JSON object holding a PerformanceRoute, which normalizePerformanceRoute maps to a closed enum of APP_ROUTES names or "other", an HMAC token that createPerformanceToken builds on the server from the authenticated session.shop and a timestamp, and the constant PERFORMANCE_ENDPOINT.
